help: Default mouse + keyboard controls: <kbd>Arrow keys</kbd> navigate, <kbd>Enter</kbd> selects, <kbd>E</kbd> confirms selections or ends the turn, and <kbd>1–0</kbd> selects a card. <kbd>D</kbd> opens the deck, <kbd>A / S / X</kbd> the draw / discard / exhaust piles, <kbd>M</kbd> the map, and <kbd>Space</kbd> toggles the view beneath a combat selection. Change either keyboard layout in the game’s Settings → Input. Save and Return is in the pause menu. Runs, history and key bindings stay in the selected browser profile. Click or drag a card onto its target; use the wheel to scroll.
about: Pinned reference: v0.111.0 / 41cef1ea. Includes the five single-player character card pools, 53 colorless cards and 64 potions, with 558 card models including event and curse cards. Expeditions use the original three-act maps, single-player encounters, events and Ancients. Original UI and animation work is ongoing in this development build. Original artwork and animation are converted offline from the player installation.
